title: Yellow Ribbon Run – 3K
subtitle: Endometriosis Foundation of India (EFI)
description: Participated in the 3K Yellow Ribbon Run in Hyderabad, an awareness run organized by the Endometriosis Foundation of India to raise awareness about endometriosis. The experience was a meaningful way to take part in a community event while staying active and supporting an important cause.

title: The Kite Runner
subtitle: Book by Khaled Hosseini
description: A moving story about friendship, guilt, and forgiveness. It shows how our past choices can affect our lives and how taking responsibility for our mistakes can help us find a way toward redemption.

customFields.label: Key Takeaway
customFields.value: It’s never too late to make amends and choose to do what is right.

title: Ikigai: The Japanese Secret to a Long and Happy Life
subtitle: By Héctor García & Francesc Miralles
description: Explored the philosophy of Ikigai—the convergence of passion, mission, vocation, and profession. A compelling perspective on finding flow in daily craftsmanship, intentional living, community bonding, and mindful resilience.

title: The Alchemist
subtitle: By Paulo Coelho
description: A timeless allegory about following one's Personal Legend, listening to one's heart, and recognizing opportunity in the journey of life. Highlights the importance of persistence and alignment with core purpose.
